newsitem.title: USA: Information Resources Q4 int'l revenues up.
newsitem.headline: Information Resources Q4 int'l revenues up.

text.p: Information Resources Inc said fourth quarter revenues from international businesses were $16.8 million, up 29 percent from the year-ago period.
The revenue gain led to a trimmed operating loss for international businesses of $5.9 million in the quarter, compared with a loss of $7.9 million in the year-ago period.
International results continued to reflect a difficult competitive pricing environment in Europe and costs associated with the ramp-up of operations in Italy, the company said.
On Wednesday, Information Resources reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.20 a share after charges, compared with break-even results a year ago.

"We continued to make encouraging progress in each of our operations during the quarter," Gian Fulgoni, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "In the U.S., the pricing environment for our base InfoScan business remained tight, but earnings grew sharply as a result of solid revenue growth and the benefit of cost containment programs."
In Europe, he added, the company's share of the market in France and Italy improved significantly.
Information Resources provides scanner-based business solutions to the consumer packaged goods industry.
